vendoring: tools/vendor-noble-pq.mjs downloads the +esm closure and rewrites every absolute /npm/ specifier to a relative sibling path, because jsDelivr's bundles would otherwise fetch dependencies from the CDN at runtime. tools/gen-pq-kat.mjs then pins cross-language KAT values; server/src tests assert RustCrypto reproduces them and tests/pq-envelopes.spec.ts asserts the browser does. tools/vendor-checksums.mjs records these hashes for tests/vendor-integrity.spec.ts.
